plan: Sell all SOXL and SPAL to eliminate leveraged ETF risk.
Trim SMH and CRWD to reduce concentration and semiconductor exposure.
Significantly trim SPY to build a cash buffer and reduce concentration.
Increase QQQI allocation to focus on income generation.
Add to QQQ to maintain broad market exposure.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation with reduced leverage.
conservative.read: This conservative approach aims for lower, steadier returns around 1.5% per month. It significantly reduces risk by cutting leveraged ETFs and building a cash buffer, accepting lower growth potential.

plan: Trim SOXL and SPAL to keep leveraged ETF exposure minimal.
Reduce SMH and CRWD to lower concentration in tech and semiconductors.
Trim SPY to bring broad index exposure closer to the target concentration.
Buy CRWV, a high-scoring scanner setup, to add a new quality name.
Buy NVDA, another strong scanner setup, to increase exposure to a leading tech name.
This plan balances risk reduction with targeted growth opportunities.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets approximately 2.5% monthly growth by reducing concentration and leverage while adding high-conviction names. It aims for risk-first growth, accepting moderate drawdowns.

plan: Trim SPY to reduce concentration and free up capital.
Trim SMH to slightly reduce semiconductor exposure.
Increase SOXL and SPAL to leverage strong uptrends in semiconductors.
Buy CRWV, a high-scoring scanner setup, to add aggressive exposure.
Buy NVDA and PLTR, both strong scanner setups, to concentrate on high-growth tech.
This plan aggressively pursues growth using leverage and concentrated bets.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% monthly growth by increasing leveraged ETF exposure and concentrating on top scanner setups. It significantly raises both potential upside and downside risk, with higher drawdowns expected due to leverage and daily rebalancing of leveraged ETFs.

plan: Sell all SOXL and SPAL to remove all leveraged ETF risk.
Trim SMH and CRWD to reduce exposure to volatile tech and semiconductors.
Trim SPY to create a cash buffer and reduce concentration.
Significantly increase QQQI to maximize focus on monthly income distributions.
Add to QQQ to maintain some broad market exposure.
This plan prioritizes steady monthly income and capital preservation.
income.read: This income-focused plan targets around 1% monthly return through distributions, prioritizing stability over growth. It minimizes risk by cutting leveraged ETFs and volatile single names, focusing on income-generating assets and a cash buffer. NAV can still decline in market downturns.
